text: Paolo has a second interview at the bank sometime next week. Really nervous, says the first panel grilled him. Text him good luck the night before.
Ayesha's sister Salma got the job at the council!! Starts early March. Ayesha was beaming.
oliver applying for jobs in leeds, wants out of retail. his girlfriend Sana is moving up there end of the month anyway

Coffee w Thabo. He's coeliac so the cafe was a nightmare lol. Says his mum's having her knee done after Christmas, he's going to stay with her for a week after. His brother Oscar can't help because he's in Dubai till spring. Thabo's also got a final interview for the operations job sometime next week and hasn't prepped at all.
Need to call Tomás about the reference letter before Friday

So Katarzyna told me her husband Aleksander was made redundant last month and he's got an interview with some logistics firm sometime in November. She's trying to stay positive but you can tell it's weighing on her. I should check in with her a week after the interview, and maybe take them both out for dinner if he gets it.
dentist moved to early december. pick up dry cleaning thurs

Emily mentioned her dad's 70th is in the spring, they're doing a big family meal. She wants to get him a vinyl player, said he's been dropping hints for years. Her brother Kofi is flying back from Accra for it, first time home in ages, and Emily is a bit stressed about hosting everyone at hers that weekend.
Rahul - Bristol interview went well apparently, hears back sometime next week. ask how it went
Ivan and Fatima are off to Lisbon over the summer for their tenth anniversary. Fatima's planning everything, Ivan just wants a beach.
Gareth's dog Biscuit had his op yesterday, groggy but fine. Gareth hardly slept the night before.
Don't forget Duc's leaving drinks, end of the month, think it's the Thursday. Get a card going round the office.
Dimitri hates his new manager. Thinking of applying elsewhere in the new year but doesn't want to rush it.
Ana's brother Gabriel - finishing his PhD soon, viva sometime in January. He's terrified apparently. She asked me not to mention it to him till afterwards.
Lwazi plays bass in a covers band, gig at the Crown on the 14th

Talked to Abigail for ages on the phone. Her mum's been in hospital since Tuesday with pneumonia, they're hoping she's home by the weekend. Abi is exhausted, juggling the kids and work. Ring her Sunday to see how things are.
Note to self: CV update, apply for the Kumar & Co role before the deadline, which is end of next week I think.
Oisín's wedding is off. He and Deepa split up a couple of weeks ago. He seemed ok-ish but quiet. Must message him over the weekend.
Ricardo starting at the hospital in the new year as a staff nurse. Proud of him. His wife Sara is expecting in the spring too, so big year.
Kofi said the interview panel is Thursday morning and the presentation is that afternoon. He wants to practise on me the day before.
anders - allergic to shellfish!! remember for the dinner
Tendai's daughter has her driving test sometime next month, third attempt. Tendai is more nervous than she is honestly.
Got a voicemail from Mrs Williams, she wants to meet about the volunteering thing early next week, no day fixed.
Sana got into the Masters at UCL. Starts in September. Send her flowers or something.

Thomas and his partner Oscar have just bought a flat in Walthamstow, moving in sometime after Christmas. Housewarming probably February. Thomas wants a proper espresso machine but they can't afford one yet, so that's a good shout for a present.
Salma's interview was cancelled, they've frozen the role. She's gutted.
Alejandro's surfing again now his shoulder's healed. Off to Cornwall at half term with the kids.
Meeting Deepa for lunch Wednesday. I'm bringing the photos from the trip.
ok so: Paolo heard back, didn't get it. Says he's fine but he isn't really. Text him over the weekend, nothing heavy.
Fatima's mum turns 60 soonish, maybe end of November? Fatima said she collects teapots, could find a nice vintage one.
Uncle Gareth retiring at Easter after 32 years at the railway. Party's the weekend after.
Duc - big job interview in Manchester the 3rd, flying up the night before. Wish him luck that morning, and ask how it went the next day.

Ivan's cat Pepper went missing on Saturday, still not back. He's put posters up everywhere and is checking the shelter every morning. His partner Deepa thinks someone's taken her in. He's properly upset, kept apologising for being distracted. Check in with him tomorrow and offer to help with leaflets on Sunday.
Ayesha does pottery on Tuesday nights and is obsessed with it. Wants to sell stuff at a market one day.

Rahul's wife Sara had the baby! A girl, born early hours of Monday. Both doing well. Rahul sounded shattered but happy, said his mum is flying in from Delhi at the weekend to help out for a month. Need to organise a gift with the others, maybe a hamper sometime next week once they're home.
Kat said Oliver's going for a promotion, team lead, interviews in a fortnight. She thinks he'll walk it but he's being weird about it.
Groceries. Return the parcel. Book MOT for sometime mid November.
Tomás's grandad passed away at the weekend. Funeral is probably next week, in Valencia. He's flying out Tuesday. Send him a message tonight.

Spoke to Emily's boss at the drinks, he was saying the department is restructuring over the summer. Didn't sound like great news for her team. Emily doesn't know yet I don't think. She's only just come back after her surgery in August and she was hoping to apply for the senior post sometime in the new year.
Lwazi Adeyemi (goes by Laz) - new guy on the five-a-side team, works as a sound engineer, lives in Peckham.
Abigail's son Oscar starts secondary in September. She's dreading the school run.

Ana has a job interview at the museum on Friday and her flat viewing on Saturday, then her parents arrive the day after. Mad week for her. The interview is for the curator assistant role she's wanted since uni, and she's been rehearsing answers with her flatmate Sana every night. Remember to text her Friday evening to ask about the interview.
Gabriel passed his viva!! Minor corrections only. Congratulate him
Katarzyna Rossi from the book club - originally from Kraków, two kids, vegetarian.
dimitri's sister Sana visiting from Athens early march. he wants to take her to see a show
Thabo's anniversary with Fatima is the 22nd, he asked me where to book. I said the Italian on Mill Road.
I'm driving Kofi to his scan on the 4th, picking him up at eight. He seemed pretty anxious about it.

Recap from the call with Oisín: he's applying for the graduate scheme at the council and also something at a charity, both deadlines are around the end of the month. He asked if I'd read over his personal statement, so I need to do that by next weekend at the latest. His mum keeps nagging him about it, which isn't helping, and he's not sleeping well. Also his brother Dimitri is back from Canada for Christmas.
Tendai's thinking about going freelance after the summer. Hasn't decided yet.
Deepa's dad has a hospital appointment sometime next week, results from the biopsy. Ask her afterwards how it went.
Ricardo hates coriander, like proper hates it. Note for the barbecue.

Big chat with Alejandro and his wife Ana last night. They're thinking about moving back to Seville in the spring, maybe sooner if his transfer comes through. She's not sure, their kids are settled at school here and her job is going really well. He seemed set on it though. Nothing decided, they're talking it over this weekend.
Anders had his first day at the new place Monday. Find out how it's going in a week or so.
Thomas mentioned his niece is in the school play the week before Christmas. He's going with his sister.
Paolo's birthday is early next month I think, the 5th or 6th. Loves Arsenal. Maybe a scarf?
Need to book train tickets for Christmas before prices go up.
Salma said her husband Ivan has a job interview in Dubai next month. If he gets it they'd move out there over the summer. She's torn about it. I should take her for coffee sometime next week.
Sara rang - Emily's hen do is the weekend of the 15th, Brighton. Pay her back for the deposit.
Rahul is training for the Manchester half in the spring. Running most mornings before work now.

Saw Gabriel and his dad at the market this morning. His dad's recovering from a fall, walking with a stick, and Gabe said the physio sessions start the week after next. Gabe himself has an interview for a teaching post on Thursday and is nervous about the lesson observation part. Wish him luck Wednesday night, then ring his dad sometime after the first physio session to see how he got on.
